Remark
[intersections of totally geodesic submanifolds]

Source: petersen:page-0242 ↗ def:pet-ch5-fixed-point-set 1. ch5:5.9.31If $N_1,N_2\subset M$ are totally geodesic, show each component of $N_1\cap N_2$ is a totally geodesic submanifold, with tangent space at $p$ the Zariski tangent space $T_pN_1\cap T_pN_2$.
